Creates the Voronoi diagram, or Thiessen polygons, of a set of points: around each point, the cell of the places closer to it than to any other point.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** vector, voronoi, thiessen<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.VoronoiDiagram`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inMap` | vector file |  |  | The input points map. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outMap` | output file |  | The output voronoi map, with the attributes of the points. |
